notes.en:
• Configure account model aliases, context/output limits and thinking settings; local overrides survive refresh and restart.
• Use website-authorized image generation/edit models with operation-bound credentials. Server limits remain authoritative and paid requests are not automatically replayed.
• Improve Windows composed rounded edges and avatar sizing. Existing API providers, conversations and manual installation remain.
notes.zh-CN:
• 登录账号后可调整模型别名、上下文、输出长度和思考设置，刷新与重启保留本地设置。
• 直接使用网站授权的生图与编辑模型；仍遵守网站权限和限额，不会自动重试付费图片请求。
• 改善 Windows 圆角合成边缘与头像大小，保留原有 API 配置、会话和手动安装方式。
